verdict.rationale: The evidence shows official MCP support plus a CLI and skills that let external AI agents such as ChatGPT or Claude work with Basecamp data. Those are building blocks an outside AI could use to write a summary, not a documented Basecamp feature that drafts project or initiative status updates from recent activity. Automatic Check-ins collect answers written by people, not AI-drafted reports.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI draft a project or initiative status update from recent activity
